female.sp: Standard CFP-010 Heindree. Use both attached official views as mechanical design authority. Preserve desaturated blue-gray armor, dark plum joints, violet sensor accents, round shoulder pivots with cap-like outer plates, oval hip panels and circular knee plates. Preserve the complete three-pronged cylindrical backpack thruster assembly as external equipment. Her RIGHT arm carries the lantern-shield weapon assembly: a small circular guard, integrated central handgun mechanism, one long slender straight lance extending above and a shorter opposing blade below; her LEFT forearm carries the separate plain oval shield. Do not replace this with a fantasy spear, a generic rifle, or a large sword. Translate the head sensor into a compact violet forehead ornament with the small single dorsal fin, leaving a fully human face unobstructed. Keep substantial shoulder caps, forearm shields and leg armor; the open design exposes collarbone, waist flanks and upper-thigh gaps between fitted segmented plates. Face distinction: a longer midface, small narrow upturned eyes, straight brows, softly defined cheekbones and a clear cupid bow; no rounded doll face. The first attached anthropomorphized image is the identity anchor for this SAME adult woman, her face geometry, silver braid, violet eyes and toned physique. The two official views are equipment design references. Completely translate all surfaces into the selected ink-wash and light-colour style, including face, armor and weapons. Use freely chosen pose and viewpoint; do not trace the first composition.
